name: Checkers Arena
summary:
Checkers Arena is a browser-based strategy board game featuring four variants of checkers and draughts. American checkers and Brazilian draughts are played on an 8×8 board, while international and Nigerian draughts use a 10×10 board. Players can challenge the computer, invite a friend to a match, or compete in timed online games and arena tournaments.

Players can also solve tactical puzzles, watch tournament games live, and replay completed games with engine analysis to explore alternative moves.
